summary.en: Wake the device on the product, push to what matters, change surface to the evidence, light its rows, land the claim, turn back for the name.
summary.zh: 在产品画面上唤醒设备，推到要点，换到证据页，逐行点亮，落下主张，翻回来给出名字。

fits: Launches whose claim can be seen on the product’s own surface: a model in a picker, a feature panel, a price, an official chart. 12–60 s.
notFor: Mechanisms, comparisons of many artefacts, products without a screen.

intent.en: A launch told only through real screens: the product, then the official evidence, then the product again.
intent.zh: 只用真实屏幕讲的发布：先是产品，再是官方证据，最后回到产品。

content.en: 3–6 real captures with named regions; 5–9 short margin lines.
content.zh: 3–6 张带命名区域的真实截图；5–9 条页边短句。

fits.zh: 能在产品自己的屏幕上看到主张的发布：选择器里的模型、一个功能面板、价格、官方图表。12–60 秒。

notFor.zh: 机制讲解、多件物料对比、没有屏幕的产品。

waive.all: an own brick split from an existing style: no upstream shot; checked instead side by side with the original template at the same moment (card, Differs from upstream)
